en: Stylized Art-Nouveau/early Modernist illustration of a pavilion-like building with a steep, multi-peaked green roof, three front bays with statues in niches, vertical decorative panels, and flower arrangements flanking the entrance. In the foreground is a patterned plaza and red-railed walkway. To the right, a flagpole flies a checkered red, white, yellow and black flag. Decorative text in a geometric type appears on the left side of the building.
